<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[// NOTE: Added $rootScope to the first line
function CLMCustomer360Controller($scope, $http, $timeout, $rootScope) {
    var c = this;

    c.searchTerm = '';
    c.loading = true;
    c.charts = {};

    c.suggestions    = [];
    c.suggestLoading = false;
    var _suggestTimer = null;

    var CHART_JS_URL = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Chart.js/2.9.4/Chart.min.js';

    function ensureChartJs(cb) {
        if (typeof Chart !== 'undefined') { cb(); return; }

        if (!window.__clmChartJsPromise) {
            window.__clmChartJsPromise = new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
                var existing = document.querySelector('script[data-clm-chartjs]');
                if (existing) {
                    existing.addEventListener('load', resolve);
                    existing.addEventListener('error', reject);
                    return;
                }
                var script = document.createElement('script');
                script.src = CHART_JS_URL;
                script.setAttribute('data-clm-chartjs', 'true');
                script.onload = resolve;
                script.onerror = reject;
                document.head.appendChild(script);
            });
        }

        window.__clmChartJsPromise.then(function() {
            $timeout(cb);
        }).catch(function(err) {
            console.error('CLM Widget: failed to load Chart.js from CDN', err);
        });
    }

    ensureChartJs(function() {});

    c.fmtLakh = function(val) {
        if (val === null || val === undefined || isNaN(val)) return '—';
        var lakh = val / 100000;
        return '₹' + (Math.round(lakh * 10) / 10).toFixed(1) + 'L';
    };

    c.fmtK = function(val) {
        if (val === null || val === undefined || isNaN(val)) return '—';
        if (val === 0) return '—';
        if (val >= 100000) return c.fmtLakh(val);
        return '₹' + Math.round(val / 1000) + 'K';
    };

    c.fmtDash = function(val) {
        return (!val || val === 0) ? '—' : c.fmtK(val);
    };

    var parseSafeNumber = function(val) {
        if (val === null || val === undefined) return 0;
        if (typeof val === 'number') return isNaN(val) ? 0 : val;
        var str = String(val).replace(/[₹\s,]/g, '').trim();
        var multiplier = 1;
        if (str.toUpperCase().endsWith('L')) { multiplier = 100000; str = str.slice(0, -1); }
        else if (str.toUpperCase().endsWith('K')) { multiplier = 1000; str = str.slice(0, -1); }
        var num = parseFloat(str);
        return isNaN(num) ? 0 : num * multiplier;
    };

    c.onTyping = function($event) {
        if ($event.keyCode === 13) {
            c.suggestions = [];
            c.doSearch();
            return;
        }
        if ($event.keyCode === 27) {
            c.suggestions = [];
            return;
        }

        var term = (c.searchTerm || '').trim();

        if (term.length < 2) {
            c.suggestions = [];
            c.suggestLoading = false;
            if (_suggestTimer) { $timeout.cancel(_suggestTimer); }
            return;
        }

        if (_suggestTimer) { $timeout.cancel(_suggestTimer); }
        _suggestTimer = $timeout(function() {
            c.suggestLoading = true;
            c.server.get({ action: 'suggest', term: term }).then(function(r) {
                c.suggestions    = r.data.suggestions || [];
                c.suggestLoading = false;
            }, function() {
                c.suggestions    = [];
                c.suggestLoading = false;
            });
        }, 250);
    };

    c.selectSuggestion = function(s) {
        c.searchTerm  = s.name;
        c.suggestions = [];
        // Suggestions now carry sysId too, so this drill-down is unambiguous
        // even if this customer's code is duplicated on another record.
        if (s.sysId) {
            c.load({ sysId: s.sysId, code: s.code });
        } else {
            c.load(s.code);
        }
    };

    // Accepts either:
    //   c.load('some text')            -> text search (code/PAN/name)
    //   c.load({ sysId: '...', code: '...' }) -> exact record lookup
    c.load = function(param) {
        c.loading = true;
        c.suggestions = [];

        var payload;
        if (param && typeof param === 'object' && param.sysId) {
            payload = { sysId: param.sysId };
            c.searchTerm = param.code || c.searchTerm;
        } else {
            payload = { search: param || '' };
            c.searchTerm = param || c.searchTerm;
        }

        c.server.get(payload).then(function(r) {
            c.data = r.data;
            c.loading = false;
            $timeout(function() {
                c.drawSalesChart();
                c.drawAgingChart();
            }, 300);
        });
    };

    c.doSearch = function() {
        if (c.searchTerm && c.searchTerm.trim() !== '') {
            c.load(c.searchTerm.trim());
        }
    };

    c.drawSalesChart = function() {
        if (!c.data || !c.data.monthly || !c.data.monthly.length) return;

        ensureChartJs(function() {
            var canvas = document.getElementById('c360SalesChart');
            if (!canvas) return;

            if (c.charts.sales) c.charts.sales.destroy();
            var rows = c.data.monthly.slice(-6);

            var chartLabels = rows.map(function(r) { return r.month || ''; });
            var volumeData  = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.salesVolume); });
            var valueData   = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.salesValue); });

            c.charts.sales = new Chart(canvas.getContext('2d'), {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: chartLabels,
                    datasets: [
                        {
                            label: 'Sales Volume (MT)',
                            data: volumeData,
                            borderColor: '#1f7a4d',
                            backgroundColor: '#1f7a4d',
                            fill: false,
                            yAxisID: 'y-axis-1',
                            tension: 0.2
                        },
                        {
                            label: 'Sales Value',
                            data: valueData,
                            borderColor: '#1c4e9c',
                            backgroundColor: '#1c4e9c',
                            fill: false,
                            yAxisID: 'y-axis-2',
                            tension: 0.2
                        }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    legend: { display: true, position: 'bottom' },
                    tooltips: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                    scales: {
                        xAxes: [{ gridLines: { color: '#e2e8f0' } }],
                        yAxes: [
                            {
                                id: 'y-axis-1', type: 'linear', position: 'left',
                                gridLines: { color: '#e2e8f0' },
                                scaleLabel: { display: true, labelString: 'Sales Volume (MT)' }
                            },
                            {
                                id: 'y-axis-2', type: 'linear', position: 'right',
                                gridLines: { drawOnChartArea: false },
                                scaleLabel: { display: true, labelString: 'Sales Value (₹)' }
                            }
                        ]
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    };

    c.drawAgingChart = function() {
        if (!c.data || !c.data.monthly || !c.data.monthly.length) return;

        ensureChartJs(function() {
            var canvas = document.getElementById('c360AgingChart');
            if (!canvas) return;

            if (c.charts.aging) c.charts.aging.destroy();
            var rows = c.data.monthly.slice(-6);

            var chartLabels = rows.map(function(r) { return r.month || ''; });
            var b0_30_Data  = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.b0_30); });
            var b31_45_Data = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.b31_45 || r.b31_60); });
            var b46_60_Data = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.b46_60 || r.b61_90); });
            var b91_p_Data  = rows.map(function(r) { return parseSafeNumber(r.b91_p); });

            c.charts.aging = new Chart(canvas.getContext('2d'), {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: chartLabels,
                    datasets: [
                        { label: '0-30D',  data: b0_30_Data,  backgroundColor: '#449e62' },
                        { label: '31-45D', data: b31_45_Data, backgroundColor: '#e29b45' },
                        { label: '46-60D', data: b46_60_Data, backgroundColor: '#d16b34' },
                        { label: '>90D',   data: b91_p_Data,  backgroundColor: '#c23737' }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    legend: { display: true, position: 'bottom' },
                    tooltips: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                    scales: {
                        xAxes: [{ stacked: true, gridLines: { display: false } }],
                        yAxes: [{
                            stacked: true, gridLines: { color: '#e2e8f0' },
                            scaleLabel: { display: true, labelString: 'Outstanding Amount (₹)' }
                        }]
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    };

    // Listens for the live broadcast (works while this widget instance is
    // alive). Payload now carries { sysId, code } instead of a bare code
    // string, so the lookup is exact even when customer_code_sap is
    // duplicated across master records.
    $rootScope.$on('clm.customer.selected', function(event, payload) {
        if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && payload.sysId) {
            c.load({ sysId: payload.sysId, code: payload.code });
        } else {
            // backward-compatible: a bare code string was broadcast
            c.load(payload);
        }
    });

    // ========================================================
    // Pending-value pickup: if the Portfolio tab is ng-if'd (rather than
    // ng-show'd) in clm_dashboard, this widget gets destroyed/recreated
    // on every tab switch, so it may not have existed yet — and therefore
    // had no listener — at the moment clm.customer.selected was broadcast.
    // $rootScope.clmPendingCustomerSysId is the fallback for that case.
    // ========================================================
    if ($rootScope.clmPendingCustomerSysId) {
        var pendingSysId = $rootScope.clmPendingCustomerSysId;
        var pendingCode  = $rootScope.clmPendingCustomerCode;
        delete $rootScope.clmPendingCustomerSysId;
        delete $rootScope.clmPendingCustomerCode;
        c.load({ sysId: pendingSysId, code: pendingCode });
    } else {
        c.load();
    }
}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* =========================================
   CLM C360 Base Styles
   ========================================= */
.clm-c360 {
    font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    background: #f4f5f7;
    padding: 20px;
}

.clm-card {
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; /* Updated to match screenshot border */
    border-radius: 4px; /* More squared off like screenshot */
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
}

.clm-error {
    padding: 16px;
    color: #b3261e;
    font-weight: 600;
    border-left: 4px solid #b3261e;
}

/* =========================================
   Search Bar & Customer Header
   ========================================= */
.clm-searchbar { padding: 12px 16px; }
.clm-search-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.clm-search-icon { font-size: 16px; }
.clm-search-label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; color: #4a5568; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

.clm-search-input {
    flex: 0 1 300px;
    height: 36px;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 13px;
    outline: none;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
.clm-search-input:focus {
    border-color: #1c4e9c;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(28, 78, 156, 0.12);
}

.clm-btn-primary {
    background: #1c4e9c;
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 0 16px;
    height: 36px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.clm-btn-primary:hover { background: #163d7a; }

.clm-search-helper { font-size: 12px; color: #718096; margin-left: 10px; }

.clm-customer-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 16px;
}
.clm-customer-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.clm-viewing { font-size: 13px; color: #718096; }
.clm-customer-name { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a1a; }
.clm-badge { padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.clm-badge-blue { background: #ebf8ff; color: #2b6cb0; }
.clm-badge-yellow { background: #fefcbf; color: #975a16; }

.clm-customer-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
.clm-header-meta { font-size: 13px; color: #4a5568; }

/* =========================================
   KPI Tiles
   ========================================= */
.clm-tiles {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.clm-tile {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    border-top: 4px solid #cbd5e0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
}

.clm-tile-blue { border-top-color: #1c4e9c; }
.clm-tile-orange { border-top-color: #e08a1e; }
.clm-tile-green { border-top-color: #1f9d55; }
.clm-tile-green-light { border-top-color: #3bb273; }
.clm-tile-teal { border-top-color: #0f9d8e; }

.clm-tile-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; }
.clm-tile-value { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; }

.clm-text-blue { color: #2b6cb0; }
.clm-text-orange { color: #dd6b20; }
.clm-text-orange-dark { color: #c05621; }
.clm-text-green { color: #38a169; }
.clm-text-teal { color: #319795; }
.clm-text-red { color: #e53e3e; }

/* =========================================
   Charts Section
   ========================================= */
.clm-chart-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
}

.clm-chart-card {
    padding: 0; /* Removing padding to match flush image */
}

.clm-chart-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
}

.clm-chart-tag {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #805ad5; /* Purple tone from mockup */
    font-weight: 600;
}

.clm-chart-wrapper {
    padding: 10px 16px 16px;
}

.clm-svg { width: 100%; height: 240px; }
.clm-line-blue { fill: none; stroke: #3182ce; stroke-width: 2; }
.clm-line-green { fill: none; stroke: #38a169; stroke-width: 2; }
.clm-axis-label { font-size: 10px; fill: #718096; font-weight: 500;}
.clm-grid-line { stroke: #e2e8f0; stroke-width: 1; }

/* =========================================
   Data Table
   ========================================= */
.clm-table-card {
    padding: 0;
}

.clm-table-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
}

.clm-table-title {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #1a1a1a;
}

.clm-table-tag {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #718096;
    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.clm-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.clm-table th {
    text-align: left;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    color: #718096;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.clm-table td {
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    color: #4a5568;
}

.clm-table tbody tr:last-child td {
    border-bottom: none;
}

.clm-table tbody tr:hover {
    background-color: #f7fafc;
}

.clm-row-strong {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #2d3748;
}
.clm-chart-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    height: 240px; 
    width: 100%;
}

.clm-chart-wrapper canvas {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
}

/* =========================================
   Typeahead / Autocomplete  ← APPENDED
   ========================================= */
.clm-typeahead-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    flex: 0 1 300px;
}

.clm-typeahead-wrapper .clm-search-input {
    flex: none;
    width: 100%;
}

.clm-suggestions {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 4px);
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #c3cfe0;
    border-radius: 4px;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10);
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 4px 0;
    z-index: 9999;
    max-height: 280px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

/* subtle top accent line so dropdown feels connected to the input */
.clm-suggestions::before {
    content: '';
    display: block;
    height: 2px;
    background: #1c4e9c;
    border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.clm-suggestions li {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    gap: 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f4f8;
}

.clm-suggestions li:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
}

.clm-suggestions li:hover {
    background: #eef4ff;
}

.clm-sug-name {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    flex: 1;
}

.clm-sug-meta {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #718096;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: #f4f5f7;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    letter-spacing: 0.2px;
}

.clm-suggestions-loading {
    pointer-events: none;
}

.clm-suggestions-loading li {
    color: #a0aec0;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    border-bottom: none;
}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>true</has_preview><id>copy_clm_tsh_customer_360</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {  }]]></link><name>copy_clm_tsh_customer_360</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {
    /* ============================================================
       TSH CUSTOMER 360 WIDGET — SERVER SCRIPT
       Outstanding/Credit Limit sourced LIVE from SAP via the
       x_birl3_clm.CLM_NEW_WSDL1 script include (SOAP: ZFSD_SNOW_CREDIT_LIMIT).
       Sales Org field CONFIRMED as "salesorg" on x_birl3_clm_clm_customer_master1.

       Sales Volume sourced from x_birl3_clm_clm_sales_data and
       Sales Value sourced from x_birl3_clm_clm_cement_rmc_bpd_values,
       both mapped via "u_customer". Each table stores one row per
       customer with a column per calendar month (u_jun_25, u_jul_25,
       ... u_may_26, and so on — these columns auto-populate as new
       months pass). For each historical month shown, we translate
       that month into its "u_mon_yy" field name and read it off the
       matching table. If the field doesn't exist yet or is blank,
       we return null so the UI shows a dash.
       ============================================================ */
    var TABLES = {
        master:      'x_birl3_clm_clm_customer_master1',
        request:     'x_birl3_clm_clm_new_credit_request',
        aging:       'x_birl3_clm_clm_aging_snapshot',
        salesVolume: 'x_birl3_clm_clm_sales_data',
        salesValue:  'x_birl3_clm_clm_cement_rmc_bpd_values'
    };

    var FIELDS = {
        custCode:    'customer_code_sap',
        custName:    'customer_name',
        custPan:     'pan',
        custRegion:  'region',
        custZone:    'zone',
        custSegment: 'segment',
        custSalesOrg: 'salesorg',   // CONFIRMED from Customer Master form
        systemMultiplier: 'system_multiplier',

        agingCustomer:    'customer',
        snapshotMonth:    'snapshot_month',
        totalOutstanding: 'total_outstanding',
        bucket0_30:       'bucket_0_30_days',
        bucket31_45:      'bucket_31_45_days',
        bucket46_60:      'bucket_46_60_days',
        bucket61_75:      'bucket_61_75_days',
        bucket76_90:      'bucket_76_90_days',
        bucket91_120:     'bucket_91_120_days',
        bucketGt120:      'bucket_gt120_days',

        salesRecordCustomer: 'u_customer' // same field name on both sales tables
    };

    var MONTH_ABBR = ['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'];

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helper: call the live SAP credit API via the script include.
    // Returns { creditLimit, outstandingAmount, availableCredit,
    // asdAmount, state, raw, success } — zeros/false on failure.
    // Logs enough detail (raw response, blank-field detection, thrown
    // errors) that a failure shows up clearly in System Logs instead
    // of silently returning zeros.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function getLiveCreditData(customerCode, salesOrg) {
        var out = {
            creditLimit: 0,
            outstandingAmount: 0,
            availableCredit: 0,
            asdAmount: 0,
            state: '',
            raw: null,
            success: false
        };

        if (!customerCode) {
            gs.error('[TSH Customer 360] getLiveCreditData called with no customer code — cannot call CLM_NEW_WSDL1.');
            return out;
        }
        if (!salesOrg) {
            gs.warn('[TSH Customer 360] Customer ' + customerCode + ' has no salesorg value on the master record — calling API with an empty SalesOrg, which SAP may reject.');
        }

        try {
            var apiCall = new x_birl3_clm.CLM_NEW_WSDL1();
            var rawResult = apiCall.getCreditDetails(customerCode, salesOrg || '');

            gs.info('[TSH Customer 360] CLM_NEW_WSDL1 raw response for ' + customerCode + '/' + salesOrg + ': ' + rawResult);

            if (!rawResult) {
                gs.error('[TSH Customer 360] CLM_NEW_WSDL1 returned an empty string for ' + customerCode + '/' + salesOrg + ' — the script include\'s own catch block likely fired. Check System Logs for a "CLM_NEW_WSDL Error :" entry, and confirm the MID Server (ABGDEV MID Server1) is Up.');
                return out;
            }

            var parsed = JSON.parse(rawResult);

            out.creditLimit       = parseFloat(parsed.creditLimit) || 0;
            out.outstandingAmount = parseFloat(parsed.outstandingAmount) || 0;
            out.availableCredit   = parseFloat(parsed.availableCredit) || 0;
            out.asdAmount         = parseFloat(parsed.ASDAmount) || 0;
            out.state             = parsed.state || '';
            out.raw = parsed;

            var allBlank = true;
            for (var k in parsed) {
                if (parsed[k]) { allBlank = false; break; }
            }
            if (allBlank) {
                gs.error('[TSH Customer 360] CLM_NEW_WSDL1 returned a JSON object but every field is blank for ' + customerCode + '/' + salesOrg + '. This means the SOAP call itself likely failed (MID Server down, auth rejected, or a SAP fault) rather than SAP genuinely having no data. Check the "SOAP Request:"/"SOAP Response:"/"HTTP Status" log lines the script include writes, and check the ecc_queue table for this transaction.');
            } else {
                out.success = true;
            }

        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('[TSH Customer 360] CLM_NEW_WSDL1 call threw an exception for ' + customerCode + '/' + salesOrg + ': ' + e.message);
        }

        return out;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helper: turn an aging-snapshot month (e.g. "2026-07-01") into the
    // matching "mon_yy" suffix used by the sales-data field names
    // (e.g. "jul_26" -> field "u_jul_26").
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function getMonthFieldSuffix(dateVal) {
        if (!dateVal) return null;
        var datePart = String(dateVal).split(' ')[0]; // strip time portion if present
        var pieces = datePart.split('-');
        if (pieces.length < 2) return null;

        var year  = parseInt(pieces[0], 10);
        var month = parseInt(pieces[1], 10);
        if (isNaN(year) || isNaN(month) || month < 1 || month > 12) return null;

        return MONTH_ABBR[month - 1] + '_' + String(year).slice(-2);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helper: read a monthly value off a sales-data/sales-value record.
    // Returns null (-> dash in the UI) if the field doesn't exist yet
    // (future month) or is blank.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function getMonthlyFieldValue(gr, monthSuffix) {
        if (!gr || !monthSuffix) return null;
        var fieldName = 'u_' + monthSuffix;
        if (!gr.isValidField(fieldName)) return null;

        var raw = gr.getValue(fieldName);
        if (raw === null || raw === undefined || raw === '') return null;

        var num = parseFloat(raw);
        return isNaN(num) ? null : num;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // TYPEAHEAD branch: lightweight suggest query, no API call needed
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (input && input.action === 'suggest') {
        var term = (input.term || '').trim();
        data.suggestions = [];

        if (term.length < 2) { return; }

        var grSug = new GlideRecord(TABLES.master);
        var qSug = grSug.addQuery(FIELDS.custName, 'STARTSWITH', term);
        qSug.addOrCondition(FIELDS.custName, 'CONTAINS', term);
        qSug.addOrCondition(FIELDS.custCode, 'STARTSWITH', term);
        qSug.addOrCondition(FIELDS.custPan,  'STARTSWITH', term);
        grSug.orderBy(FIELDS.custName);
        grSug.setLimit(8);
        grSug.query();

        var seen = {};
        while (grSug.next()) {
            var code = grSug.getValue(FIELDS.custCode);
            if (seen[code]) { continue; }
            seen[code] = true;
            data.suggestions.push({
                sysId: grSug.getUniqueValue(),
                name: grSug.getValue(FIELDS.custName),
                code: code,
                pan:  grSug.getValue(FIELDS.custPan)
            });
        }
        return;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // FULL LOAD branch
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    data.error = null;
    data.initialLoad = false;
    data.customer = null;
    data.liveApiOk = false; // surfaced to the client so it can show a soft warning if the live call failed

    var directSysId = (input && input.sysId) ? input.sysId : '';
    var rawSearch = (input && input.search) ? input.search : (options.search || options.customer_code || $sp.getParameter('search') || '');
    var searchTerm = rawSearch.trim();

    if (!directSysId && !searchTerm) {
        data.initialLoad = true;
        return;
    }

    // 1. Resolve Customer
    var grCust = new GlideRecord(TABLES.master);

    if (directSysId) {
        if (!grCust.get(directSysId)) {
            data.error = 'Customer record not found.';
            return;
        }
    } else {
        var qc = grCust.addQuery(FIELDS.custCode, searchTerm);
        qc.addOrCondition(FIELDS.custPan, searchTerm);
        qc.addOrCondition(FIELDS.custName, 'CONTAINS', searchTerm);
        grCust.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        grCust.setLimit(1);
        grCust.query();

        if (!grCust.next()) {
            data.error = 'No customer found matching "' + searchTerm + '".';
            return;
        }
    }

    var custSysId    = grCust.getUniqueValue();
    var custCode     = grCust.getValue(FIELDS.custCode);
    var custSalesOrg = grCust.getValue(FIELDS.custSalesOrg);

    data.customer = {
        name:    grCust.getValue(FIELDS.custName),
        code:    custCode,
        pan:     grCust.getValue(FIELDS.custPan),
        region:  grCust.getDisplayValue(FIELDS.custRegion),
        zone:    grCust.getDisplayValue(FIELDS.custZone),
        segment: grCust.getDisplayValue(FIELDS.custSegment)
    };

    // 2. LIVE credit data from SAP (replaces current_credit_limit / outstanding_amount)
    var live = getLiveCreditData(custCode, custSalesOrg);
    var currentLimit       = live.creditLimit;
    var currentOutstanding = live.outstandingAmount;
    data.liveApiOk = live.success;

    // 3. Get Multiplier (still from the request table — API doesn't provide this)
    var sdMultiplier = 0;
    var grReq = new GlideRecord(TABLES.request);
    grReq.addQuery('customer', custSysId);
    grReq.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
    grReq.setLimit(1);
    grReq.query();
    if (grReq.next()) {
        sdMultiplier = parseFloat(grReq.getValue(FIELDS.systemMultiplier)) || 0;
    }

    // 3b. Look up this customer's row (one row per customer) on each
    //     monthly sales table, once, so the loop below can just read
    //     the relevant "u_mon_yy" field off each per iteration.
    var grSalesVol = new GlideRecord(TABLES.salesVolume);
    grSalesVol.addQuery(FIELDS.salesRecordCustomer, custSysId);
    grSalesVol.setLimit(1);
    grSalesVol.query();
    var salesVolGr = grSalesVol.next() ? grSalesVol : null;

    var grSalesVal = new GlideRecord(TABLES.salesValue);
    grSalesVal.addQuery(FIELDS.salesRecordCustomer, custSysId);
    grSalesVal.setLimit(1);
    grSalesVal.query();
    var salesValGr = grSalesVal.next() ? grSalesVal : null;

    // 4. 6-Month Historical Data from Aging Snapshot.
    //    The live API only returns a *current* point-in-time figure, not
    //    history, so month-by-month "outstanding" in this table still
    //    comes from the aging snapshot table. "limit" now reflects the
    //    live SAP credit limit for every row. Sales Volume and Sales
    //    Value are pulled per-month from the two dedicated monthly
    //    sales tables (null -> dash in the UI if that month's field
    //    doesn't exist yet or is blank).
    var rows = [];
    var grAge = new GlideRecord(TABLES.aging);
    grAge.addQuery(FIELDS.agingCustomer, custSysId);
    grAge.orderByDesc(FIELDS.snapshotMonth);
    grAge.setLimit(6);
    grAge.query();

    while (grAge.next()) {
        var b0   = parseFloat(grAge.getValue(FIELDS.bucket0_30))   || 0;
        var b31  = parseFloat(grAge.getValue(FIELDS.bucket31_45))  || 0;
        var b46  = parseFloat(grAge.getValue(FIELDS.bucket46_60))  || 0;
        var b61  = parseFloat(grAge.getValue(FIELDS.bucket61_75))  || 0;
        var b76  = parseFloat(grAge.getValue(FIELDS.bucket76_90))  || 0;
        var b91  = parseFloat(grAge.getValue(FIELDS.bucket91_120)) || 0;
        var b120 = parseFloat(grAge.getValue(FIELDS.bucketGt120))  || 0;

        var snapOutst = parseFloat(grAge.getValue(FIELDS.totalOutstanding));
        if (isNaN(snapOutst)) { snapOutst = b0 + b31 + b46 + b61 + b76 + b91 + b120; }

        var monthSuffix   = getMonthFieldSuffix(grAge.getValue(FIELDS.snapshotMonth));
        var salesVolumeVal = getMonthlyFieldValue(salesVolGr, monthSuffix);
        var salesValueVal  = getMonthlyFieldValue(salesValGr, monthSuffix);

        rows.push({
            month:       grAge.getDisplayValue(FIELDS.snapshotMonth),
            limit:       currentLimit,
            outstanding: snapOutst,
            salesVolume: salesVolumeVal, // null -> dash when that month has no data yet
            salesValue:  salesValueVal,  // null -> dash when that month has no data yet
            b0_30:       b0,
            b31_45:      b31,
            b46_60:      b46,
            b61_90:      b61 + b76,
            b91_p:       b91 + b120,
            util:        currentLimit > 0 ? Math.round((snapOutst / currentLimit) * 100) : 0
        });
    }

    data.monthly = rows.reverse();

    // 5. KPI Indicators — LIVE from SAP
    var latest = data.monthly.length > 0 ? data.monthly[data.monthly.length - 1] : null;

    data.indicators = {
        limit:        currentLimit,
        outstanding:  currentOutstanding,
        available:    currentLimit - currentOutstanding,
        utilisation:  currentLimit > 0 ? Math.round((currentOutstanding / currentLimit) * 100) : 0,
        sdMultiplier: sdMultiplier,
        od90:         latest ? latest.b91_p : 0,
        od90Clean:    (latest ? latest.b91_p : 0) <= 0
    };
})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>vedant.salunke@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-16 11:55:16</sys_created_on><sys_id>b01af7222b8e47104572f3745e91bf8b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>copy_clm_tsh_customer_360</sys_name><sys_package display_value="CLM" source="x_birl3_clm">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="CLM">d01e8ce22bb27e104572f3745e91bfe3</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_b01af7222b8e47104572f3745e91bf8b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>devendra.pandey@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-17 09:02:15</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="clm-c360">

    <div class="clm-card clm-searchbar">
        <div class="clm-search-wrapper">
            <span class="clm-search-icon">🔍</span>
            <span class="clm-search-label">CUSTOMER SEARCH</span>
            <div class="clm-typeahead-wrapper">
                <input type="text"
                       class="clm-search-input"
                       placeholder="e.g. PAN, Customer Code, or Name"
                       ng-model="c.searchTerm"
                       ng-keyup="c.onTyping($event)"
                       autocomplete="off">
                <ul class="clm-suggestions" ng-if="c.suggestions.length > 0">
                    <li ng-repeat="s in c.suggestions"
                        ng-mousedown="c.selectSuggestion(s)">
                        <span class="clm-sug-name">{{s.name}}</span>
                        <span class="clm-sug-meta">{{s.code}} · {{s.pan}}</span>
                    </li>
                </ul>
                <div class="clm-suggestions clm-suggestions-loading" ng-if="c.suggestLoading">
                    <li>Searching…</li>
                </div>
            </div>
            <button class="clm-btn-primary" ng-click="c.doSearch()">Search</button>
            <span class="clm-search-helper">or click any customer in Portfolio Overview tab</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div ng-if="c.data.error" class="clm-card clm-error">
        {{c.data.error}}
    </div>

    <div ng-if="!c.data.error">

        <div class="clm-card clm-customer-header">
            <div class="clm-customer-left">
                <span class="clm-viewing">Viewing</span>
                <strong class="clm-customer-name">{{c.data.customer.name}}</strong>
                <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-blue">{{c.data.customer.code}}</span>
                <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-yellow">{{c.data.customer.segment}}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="clm-customer-right">
                <span class="clm-header-meta">{{c.data.customer.pan}} · {{c.data.customer.zone}} · {{c.data.customer.region}}</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-tiles">
            <div class="clm-tile clm-tile-blue">
                <div class="clm-tile-label">LIMIT</div>
                <div class="clm-tile-value clm-text-blue">{{c.fmtLakh(c.data.indicators.limit)}}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="clm-tile clm-tile-orange">
                <div class="clm-tile-label">OUTSTANDING</div>
                <div class="clm-tile-value clm-text-orange">{{c.fmtLakh(c.data.indicators.outstanding)}}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="clm-tile clm-tile-green">
                <div class="clm-tile-label">AVAILABLE</div>
                <div class="clm-tile-value clm-text-green">{{c.fmtLakh(c.data.indicators.available)}}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="clm-tile clm-tile-green-light">
                <div class="clm-tile-label">UTILISATION</div>
                <div class="clm-tile-value clm-text-green">{{c.data.indicators.utilisation}}%</div>
            </div>
            <div class="clm-tile clm-tile-teal">
                <div class="clm-tile-label">SD MULTIPLIER</div>
                <div class="clm-tile-value clm-text-teal">{{c.data.indicators.sdMultiplier}}x</div>
            </div>
            <div class="clm-tile clm-tile-red">
                <div class="clm-tile-label">OD >90D</div>
                <div class="clm-tile-value clm-text-red">{{c.data.indicators.od90Clean ? 'Clean' : c.fmtLakh(c.data.indicators.od90)}}</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-chart-row">
            <div class="clm-card clm-chart-card">
                <div class="clm-chart-title">
                    IND-012/013 · Sales Volume & Value (6M)
                    <span class="clm-chart-tag">Dual-Axis Line</span>
                </div>
                <div class="clm-chart-wrapper" style="position: relative; height: 240px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px;">
                    <canvas id="c360SalesChart"></canvas>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="clm-card clm-chart-card">
                <div class="clm-chart-title">
                    IND-005 · Aging Breakdown (6M)
                    <span class="clm-chart-tag-green" style="font-size: 11px; color: #1f7a4d; background: #e3f4ea; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600;">Stacked Bar</span>
                </div>
                <div class="clm-chart-wrapper" style="position: relative; height: 240px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px;">
                    <canvas id="c360AgingChart"></canvas>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-card clm-table-card">
            <div class="clm-table-header">
                <div class="clm-table-title">6-Month Detail Table</div>
                <span class="clm-table-tag">Last 6 months</span>
            </div>
            <table class="clm-table">
                <thead>
                    <tr>
                        <th>MONTH</th>
                        <th>LIMIT</th>
                        <th>UTIL %</th>
                        <th>SALES VOL (MT)</th>
                        <th>SALES VALUE</th>
                        <th>OUTSTANDING</th>
                        <th class="clm-text-red">OD >90D</th>
                        <th class="clm-text-orange-dark">46-60D</th>
                        <th class="clm-text-orange">31-45D</th>
                        <th>0-30D</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    <tr ng-repeat="row in c.data.monthly">
                        <td class="clm-row-strong">{{row.month}}</td>
                        <td class="clm-text-blue">{{c.fmtLakh(row.limit)}}</td>
                        <td class="clm-text-green">{{row.util}}%</td>
                        <td>{{row.salesVolume ? row.salesVolume + ' MT' : '—'}}</td>
                        <td>{{c.fmtDash(row.salesValue)}}</td>
                        <td>{{c.fmtLakh(row.outstanding)}}</td>
                        <td class="clm-text-red">{{c.fmtDash(row.b91_p)}}</td>
                        <td class="clm-text-orange-dark">{{c.fmtDash(row.b46_60)}}</td>
                        <td class="clm-text-orange">{{c.fmtDash(row.b31_45)}}</td>
                        <td>{{c.fmtK(row.b0_30)}}</td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr ng-if="c.data.monthly.length === 0">
                        <td colspan="10" style="text-align: center; padding: 20px;">No historical data available for this customer.</td>
                    </tr>
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>

    </div>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget><sys_es_latest_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><id>b01af7222b8e47104572f3745e91bf8b</id><sys_created_by>vedant.salunke@mindsprint.com</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-16 11:55:17</sys_created_on><sys_id>3c1af7222b8e47104572f3745e91bf9c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>vedant.salunke@mindsprint.com</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-16 11:55:17</sys_updated_on><table>sp_widget</table><use_es_latest>true</use_es_latest></sys_es_latest_script></record_update>
